title: watch
description: Dispatcher supervision: gather evidence, classify (absorb/surface), print a digest. --check peeks with no state change; --check --ack additionally journals surfaced/delivered facts and advances the surfaced watermark for emitted events; bare watch blocks until something surfaces. Exit 0 = digest emitted, 3 = nothing to report.

check.description: one-shot: classify current state, print the digest, exit (0 digest / 3 nothing)

ack.description: with --check: durably surface - journal facts + advance the surfaced watermark for emitted events

hook.description: agent-hook protocol mode (stop | prompt-submit): seat-gated output shaping, wired by the agent delivery capability

loop.description: blocking mode: keep watching and printing digests until the timeout

timeout.description: blocking mode: max seconds to wait before exiting 3
